title: Missing padding validation for All-1 fragments
description: Line 197 validates that non-All-1 fragments have zero padding bits, but All-1 fragments skip this check. While MIC verification will eventually catch corrupted All-1 data, earlier detection via padding check provides faster failure and better diagnostics.
close_reason: Fixed: Extended padding validation to All-1 fragments in Fragment::from_bytes (line 197). Added test to verify corrupted All-1 padding returns NonZeroPadding error.
